reviews.text:
Haughty, unpleasant, ill-mannered...
Very disappointed in this person...
Not very professional...
Text message to book an appointment, response within an hour, appointment for the next day, my cocker spaniel "Tazou" had a perfect grooming session. I highly recommend them. Thanks again for Tazou!

Thank you for responding to my message when I request an appointment for my dog.
Lebron is certainly not easy to groom (Shiba Inu), but a message refusing the appointment with an explanation would have been appreciated rather than ignoring the customer and making them leave.
Since it seems I have to leave a negative review to get a response (you also don't answer calls), a discount would have been appreciated, given that the last two times my husband bathed him at your establishment. Clearly, honesty and professionalism are no longer present. A simple "I can no longer take care of your dog" would have sufficed. A refusal, even a direct one, is always more respectful than silence.
I was warned about this when I came to your salon. Lebron found another groomer, and everything went very well without my husband or me intervening.
Have a good day!
Delighted with the grooming for our Australian Shepherd Simba; even though he's moved around quite a bit, the cut is perfect. See you in September!

A salon you can choose with complete confidence and safety. First grooming session for Minette, 15 years old. The groomer had the patience of a saint, with sure and gentle touches. Definite professionalism and a lot of empathy for both the cat and her owners 😂 …
Fantastic grooming salon and a superb team! My sheepdog turned back into a cocker spaniel under their magic touch! See you very soon.

Delighted with this first encounter between our cat and the groomer!
Our cat was put at ease with professionalism and gentleness, and she left without any knots and relaxed.
I'm beyond thrilled! 😁 …

Excellent grooming salon. Margaux is incredibly kind, caring, professional, and very attentive to animals. It's rare to find someone so competent.
Thank you, we'll be back.

Automne's first grooming session at Snob Dog, and definitely not the last!
A super friendly, very professional, and very conscientious team. Thanks again 😊 …

I highly recommend Snob Dog. Margaux and her team are fantastic. She's gentle and attentive with our beloved dogs. I take my two Pomeranians there and I'm always delighted with their haircuts. She has a really good hand and is very experienced with this breed! Go without hesitation, and the price is very reasonable!
Fantastic grooming salon! I took my little Brittany Spaniel, Yuuki, and received excellent advice. My dog ​​came out looking beautiful, and the staff were friendly. Thank you again!
My Pomsky came out even more beautiful, thank you so much, I highly recommend it.
Super groomer Margaux is a lovely and attentive girl. I highly recommend her for your pets. A sensational grooming session, a haircut, and a wonderful fragrance... thank you again, see you soon!
Unparalleled efficiency and gentleness. I highly recommend this salon 🙂 …

My dog ​​is transformed; she looks magnificent.

The staff is welcoming and professional. We are delighted with the result. We highly recommend this salon.
I brought my Argentinian Mastiff back for a full grooming. Margaux was very kind, caring and gentle, I thank her and I 100% recommend this salon.
A very good team made up of very pleasant young girls, great haircut for our Poopy, thank you to Margot and her team.

If you're looking for THE groomer, this is the place to go!
Margaux is very professional and gentle with animals. My dog ​​has never looked so good. Be sure to book your appointments well in advance because, naturally, such a good professional is very popular and therefore has a long wait. 😉 …
